ui.purpose: All interface chrome — nav, dialogs, forms, labels.

quran-standalone.purpose: Quran verse/word display outside the mushaf page route (search, marks, tooltips).

quran-word-on-page.purpose: Print-accurate mushaf page rendering only — one font per physical page.

surah-name.purpose: Calligraphic surah-name display; keyed by zero-padded surah number, not Arabic text.

shadows.name: reader-chrome-bar-shadow
shadows.purpose: Floating reader chrome (nav arrows, recitation bar) in light/gold; none in dark, where a raised face + warm rim carry the lift instead.

shadows.name: mushaf-page-cast
shadows.purpose: Cast shadow seating the mushaf page on its desk (light/gold only; transparent in dark).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button used across app chrome (save, confirm, submit).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background: hsl(163 86% 35%); color: #ffffff; border: none; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(163 86% 35% / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(163 86% 35%), 0 0 0 4px #ffffff; }

components.name: Reader Nav Arrow
components.description: Circular navigation control flanking the mushaf reader spread — signature component, never an icon-as-button.

components.css: .ds-nav-arrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid hsl(210 31% 90%); color: hsl(209 36% 14%); transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-arrow:hover { background: hsl(165 53% 93%); color: hsl(163 86% 35%); }

components.name: Mushaf Page Card
components.description: The print-accurate mushaf reading surface — flat paper fill, depth carried entirely by edge tokens (rim, sheet stack, cast shadow), never a lit face.
components.html:
✦
Mushaf page content
components.css: .ds-mushaf-card { position: relative; border-radius: 20px; background: #fdfdfc; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.95), inset 1px 0 0 rgba(40,50,62,0.07), inset -1px 0 0 rgba(40,50,62,0.07), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(40,50,62,0.11), 0 20px 44px -20px rgba(30,41,59,0.4), 0 5px 14px -7px rgba(30,41,59,0.2); padding: 32px; } .ds-mushaf-corner { position: absolute; font-size: 14px; color: hsl(163 86% 35% / 0.6); pointer-events: none; } .ds-corner-tl { top: 10px; left: 10px; }

components.name: Corner Star Ornament
components.description: Four-point star ornament marking each corner of the mushaf page card — reading-surface identity, not general UI chrome.
components.css: .ds-corner-star { color: hsl(163 86% 35%); opacity: 0.6; pointer-events: none; fill: currentColor; }

components.name: Section Header Band
components.description: Three-column RTL header used above reading-surface content: metadata / centered diamond-flanked title / secondary metadata.

narrative.overview: Furqan is built to feel like sitting down with a real, physical mushaf — not a generic SaaS reading pane. Every surface commits to that: pages are print-accurate rather than reflowed, cards carry paper-like depth (rim light, sheet stack, binding crease) instead of a flat drop shadow, and the single accent color is used the way ink or gold leaf would be used on a real page — sparingly, deliberately, never as decoration for its own sake. Chrome (nav, dialogs, settings) is quieter and more conventional; the mushaf reader itself is where the craft concentrates. The system runs three parallel themes — light, gold, dark — each a complete, independently tuned palette rather than a light/dark pair with a tint swapped in. Light is deliberately a modern, cool-neutral reading surface so gold can own the traditional illuminated-manuscript register on its own; dark carries page depth from light rather than shadow, since shadows are structurally invisible on its near-black background.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color used sparingly across all chrome
Print-accurate mushaf pages — never a reflowed text stream
Paper-like depth via rim/sheet/crease tokens, not conventional box-shadow, wherever a shadow would be structurally invisible
Three complete, independently-tuned theme palettes (light / gold / dark)
Manuscript ornamentation reserved for reading surfaces, not general UI chrome

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: --primary (aliased to --gold/--gold-muted where no separate gold identity exists) is the only interactive/ornamental accent color in the system. Never introduce a second hue for emphasis.

rules.name: The Gold-Is-Identity Rule
rules.body: --gold/--gold-muted mark mushaf-identity elements only — never interactive controls; --primary/--accent cover interaction.

rules.name: The Semantic Token Rule
rules.body: Never hardcode a hex/RGB value or a raw Tailwind color utility — always the semantic token (bg-background, text-foreground, etc.).

rules.name: The Column–Font Contract Rule
rules.body: Every Quran-text rendering context has exactly one correct source column and one correct font — never mix across rows.

rules.name: The Flat Face Rule
rules.body: The mushaf page face never carries a lighting gradient or radial highlight — depth is edge-only, in every theme, at every breakpoint.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Where light/gold reach for a box-shadow to seat a surface, dark reaches for a flat lightness step and a warm rim instead.

dos: Do use only semantic Tailwind color tokens — never a raw hex, RGB, or bg-gray-*/bg-white/text-black utility.
Do use hsl(var(--token)) / HSL triplets as the canonical color format when adding a new token.
Do carry the mushaf reading page's depth through rim/sheet/crease tokens matching the active theme's Elevation strategy.
Do use start/end logical Tailwind variants, not left/right, for anything that must mirror correctly in RTL.
Do follow the Column–Font Contract exactly when rendering any Quran text.
donts: Don't add a second accent color anywhere in the system.
Don't put a lighting gradient or radial highlight on the mushaf page face in any theme.
Don't reach for box-shadow to lift the dark-theme reader page or its chrome.
Don't use a filled/circle-wrapped icon variant for reader navigation.
Don't feed a surah's Arabic name text to the surah-name font.
